Bombay High Court Orders Takedown of Deepfakes Targeting Minister Gadkari

The Bombay High Court has ordered social media platforms to remove "vile and abusive" deepfake videos targeting Union Minister Nitin Gadkari. The videos falsely linked Gadkari to the E20 ethanol policy. The court expressed concern over the lack of a mechanism to remove such content without judicial intervention, noting individuals are forced to approach courts for relief. The court granted urgent interim relief to the minister against several platforms, stating such material has no place on public platforms.
